name: battle_enemy_art_centered
description: Enemy battle art is centered on the 6-column name slot: the 3-wide slime art stamps at slot_x+1 (not left-aligned at slot_x), rows 3-4 (art rows). The slime is single-frame art (artist removed frame 2), so frame 0 tiles show at any timer parity. Catches a regression to left-aligned art or a caret/art centering drift.
